subject: API analytics contract clarifications & mop-up items
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Amplitude Renewals <renewals@amplitude.com>, Segment Account Team <acct@segment.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: API analytics contract clarifications & mop-up items

Hi all,

Picking up the thread on our upcoming renewals: Redwood is evaluating whether to consolidate API telemetry ingestion on Amplitude or keep a dual-path with Segment for certain integrator flows. Before procurement locks terms, we need clarity on a few items so Legal/Procurement can finalize the SOW and PO. Attached a working migration matrix (Redwood_Migration_Matrix.xlsx).

Key clarifications we need from both vendors:
- Proration model if we move 30–50% of event volume mid-term (billing impact and effective date).
- Contractual overlap: can we run both side-by-side for a short soak period without double-billing for the samedataset?
- Data residency / ingress: we have EU customers routed through our EU region. Any additional egress fees or cross-region billing we should expect?
- Support SLA coverage during ingestion cutover (who owns replay/backfill failures).
- Standard SOW termination windows and transition assistance (hours, ramp-down pricing).

Please respond with the appropriate contact for commercial redlines (legal cc optional) and any suggested timeline constraints. Proposed internal timeline: decide consolidation approach by 2027-02-05, have PO issued by 2027-02-18.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Price <lauren.price@amplitude.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: renewals@amplitude.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:07:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: API analytics contract clarifications & mop-up items

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear list and the migration matrix. Quick notes from Amplitude side: we can support a phased migration and we do not double-bill for duplicate ingestion if you provide an agreed event list and time windows (we’ll pro-rate based on usage attribution). More specifically:

- Proration: we support daily pro-rating on event counts; billing adjustments are reflected on the next invoice cycle. If you move 30–50% mid-term, expect a pro-rated credit or charge based on actuals.
- Side-by-side runs: we can provide a temporary complimentary parallel ingestion for up to 30 days for migration validation; beyond that, we’d need a short-term addendum.
- Data residency: EU ingestion needs the EU region tenancy; no egress fee for EU->EU but cross-region analytics that require replication will incur a modest fee (we estimate ~2–4% of the ingestion cost depending on volume).
- Support/SLA: we’ll assign a named solutions engineer for the cutover window and include 8 hours of migration assistance in the standard renewal for customers in your tier; extended support blocks are available (SOW).
- Termination/transition: standard 60-day termination notice on annual contracts; transition assistance billed as T&M or fixed-price SOW.

I attached a short pricing supplement and the contact for our commercial counsel (commercial@amplitude.com). If you want, we can put together a short one-pager that maps items in your matrix to our recommended approach.

Best,
Lauren Price
Strategic Renewals — Amplitude
Attachment: SOW_pricing_supplement.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 13:29:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: API analytics contract clarifications & mop-up items

Jordan — thanks for initiating. A couple of procurement/ops notes:
- Legal asked for a contract redline window of 5 business days once we receive the redline. Please loop Legal (I’ll add them once we have the vendor doc).
- For budgeting, Finance prefers to see estimated monthly token/event counts both pre and post migration; helpful if vendors can provide a sample invoice calc.
- Naomi: can you confirm SOC 2 evidence we need to collect from each vendor for the renewal packets? Also confirm retention policy differences (Amplitude vs Segment) to identify any data export work.

I’ll start a shared folder and add the migration matrix. We should also lock a 30–45 minute alignment call this week to get the SOW path decided.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Procurement | Redwood Inference
From: Miguel Santos <miguel.s@segment.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: acct@segment.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: API analytics contract clarifications & mop-up items

Hi Jordan — appreciate the detail. A few points from Segment: 

- Proration/overlap: Segment doesn’t charge for duplicate events in a transition window if you provide an agreed event mapping and we run a reconciliation report; typical complimentary overlap is 14 days, extensions available via short addendum.
- EU region: we have a regional tenancy option and will include a breakdown of cross-region charges; sounds like Amplitude has a similar stance.
- SOW: attached a draft SOW that outlines migration coordination and optional replay assistance (SOW_draft_Amplitude_v2.pdf attached for your reference — we use the same structure).

I’d like to propose a 30-minute sync Thursday 2027-01-21 at 10:00 PT to align on the timeline and who owns backfill/reconciliation. Are you available?

Regards,
Miguel Santos
Customer Solutions — Segment (Twilio)
Attachment: Segment_pricing_comparison_2027.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Price <lauren.price@amplitude.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel.s@segment.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, procurement@optimetrics.io
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: API analytics contract clarifications & mop-up items

Thanks — this is helpful and actionable. Quick recap and next steps (action owners):

1) Alignment call: Thursday 2027-01-21 @ 10:00 PT — confirmed. Agenda: pro-ration examples, overlap windows, EU tenancy mechanics, and a short SOW checklist. (Owner: Jordan to run, vendors to present).
2) Migration matrix updates: I’ve added vendor comments into the shared sheet. Marissa will collect the finance estimates we need for PO. (Owner: Jordan/Marissa)
3) Security evidence: Naomi, please pull current SOC 2 artifacts and send the checklist back to both vendors by EOD Friday. (Owner: Naomi)
4) SOW/Legal: Vendors to provide draft SOW language and commercial counsel contact for redlines — vendors said they have drafts. Legal will aim for 5 business days review once we receive. (Owner: Vendors/Redwood Legal)
5) Timeline: Decision point on consolidation approach 2027-02-05; PO by 2027-02-18.

Please treat the call as our single sync to avoid duplicate threads. If anyone needs to add a prep doc, drop it in the Google sheet link above. I’ll send the calendar invite with dial-in + the short agenda now.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference
